title: The octave
summary: Every letter comes back higher and lower. The jump between two of them is an octave.

steps.title: Same name, higher or lower
steps.body:
Play a C, then the next C to the right. They sound like the same note, one higher than the other. The jump from a note to the next note with the same letter is an **octave**.

**Why it matters:** Notes an octave apart share a name and blend so well they almost sound like one note. That is why a tune played higher is still the same tune, and why the band can say "play it an octave up".

steps.title: Octaves of G
steps.body: Each G is an octave away from the next one.

steps.title: Same tune, new place
steps.body: Play a tune you know, then play it again an octave higher. Same tune, brighter sound.
